The '''Naos III Mercantile''' was a company on the remote [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Naos III/Legends|Naos III]], which oversaw the harvest and export of the [[Naos sharptooth]] and held a virtual monopoly on the moon businesses.
